description: Fetch detail for a specific earthquake by USGS event ID. Returns the same normalized event a search result carries, plus a projection of the analysis products only the single-event response holds: PAGER impact alert and report link, ShakeMap peak intensity and ground motion, DYFI felt-report totals, the moment-tensor focal mechanism, landslide and liquefaction alerts, origin quality (azimuthal gap, station count, location uncertainty), and finite-fault rupture dimensions. Product groups are omitted when no projected field is available — a small automatic event typically has no detail at all, while a large reviewed one has most of it. Event IDs appear in the "id" field of earthquake_get_feed and earthquake_search_events results. This tool accepts USGS event IDs only.

event_id.description: USGS event ID, e.g. "hv74966427" or "us6000sznj". Found in the "id" field of earthquake_get_feed and earthquake_search_events results.

name: earthquake_get_event

detail.description: Projected USGS analysis products. Absent when no projected field is available; absence does not mean impact was zero.

dyfi.description: Felt-report summary. Absent without projected fields.

map_url.description: URL of the rendered DYFI intensity map image.

max_cdi.description: Maximum Community Decimal Intensity derived from those reports (0–12 scale).

responses.description: Public DYFI (Did You Feel It?) report count.

finite_fault.description: Finite-fault rupture model for large events; absent without projected fields.

model_url.description: URL of the finite-fault rupture model file.

rupture_length_km.description: Modeled rupture length along strike, in kilometers.

rupture_width_km.description: Modeled rupture width down dip, in kilometers.

ground_failure.description: Secondary-hazard alert levels. Absent without projected fields.

losspager.description: PAGER assessment; fatality/economic-loss brackets are in report_url, not this projection. Absent without projected fields.

report_url.description: URL of the PAGER one-page PDF summary of estimated impact.

moment_tensor.description: Focal mechanism; absent without projected fields.

nodal_plane_1.description: First nodal plane; either plane may be the fault.

dip.description: Fault plane dip in degrees from horizontal (0–90).

rake.description: Slip direction, degrees (-180..180): ~90 reverse, ~-90 normal, ~0/180 strike-slip.

strike.description: Fault plane strike in degrees clockwise from north (0–360).

nodal_plane_2.description: Auxiliary nodal plane; seismic data alone cannot distinguish the true fault.

dip.description: Fault plane dip in degrees from horizontal (0–90).

rake.description: Slip direction, degrees (-180..180): ~90 reverse, ~-90 normal, ~0/180 strike-slip.

strike.description: Fault plane strike in degrees clockwise from north (0–360).

origin.description: Location-quality metrics for the preferred origin; absent without projected fields.

azimuthal_gap_deg.description: Largest station azimuthal gap, degrees; >~180 means poorly constrained location.

num_stations_used.description: Number of seismic stations used in the location solution.

review_status.description: Origin review state published by its network.

shakemap.description: ShakeMap modeled ground-motion summary. Absent without projected fields.

code_version.description: ShakeMap producer code version reported by USGS.

intensity_map_url.description: URL of the rendered ShakeMap intensity map image.

max_mmi.description: Maximum modeled shaking intensity across the ShakeMap grid (Modified Mercalli).

max_pga.description: Maximum modeled peak ground acceleration, in g (fraction of standard gravity).

max_pgv.description: Maximum modeled peak ground velocity, in cm/s.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `event_deleted`: USGS reports that the requested event was deleted. `not_found`: No event matches the provided event_id. `source_unavailable`: The USGS event API returns a 5xx, serves HTML, or is unreachable. `source_timeout`: The USGS event API did not answer before the request deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

alert.description: PAGER estimated impact; null without an assessment or for EMSC.

auth.description: Authoritative agency/network code (EMSC auth or USGS net); absent if unpublished.

cdi.description: Maximum DYFI Community Decimal Intensity (0–12); null if uncomputed or unsupported (EMSC).

depth_km.description: Hypocenter depth in km; null if unmeasured.

detail_url.description: URL to fetch the full GeoJSON detail record. Present in USGS list responses.

event_certainty.description: EMSC classification certainty: known (asserted), suspected, unknown, or unreported. Suspected is not confirmed. Absent for USGS and unrecognized EMSC codes.

event_type.description: QuakeML classification (earthquake, quarry blast, explosion, etc.). EMSC codes decode to USGS names; unknown codes pass through verbatim. Certainty is separate. Absent if unpublished; either catalog includes non-tectonic events.

event_url.description: USGS event page URL. Present for USGS events only.

felt.description: DYFI (Did You Feel It?) response count; null if no USGS reports or source has no DYFI (EMSC). Null does not mean unfelt.

magnitude.description: Preferred magnitude; null if not computed (title: "M ?").

magnitude_type.description: Magnitude type (ml, mww, mw, mb, etc.).

mmi.description: Maximum ShakeMap Modified Mercalli intensity (0–12); null without a ShakeMap or for EMSC.

significance.description: USGS significance (0–2000+), combining magnitude, felt reports and PAGER; null if uncomputed or for EMSC.

source_catalog.description: Solution catalog, e.g. EMSC-RTS (real-time, subject to revision). Absent for USGS.

status.description: Review state: automatic (unverified), reviewed (analyst checked), or deleted. Null if unpublished (EMSC); such solutions remain unverified and subject to revision.

tsunami.description: USGS tsunami flag: 1 for large oceanic events, 0 otherwise; null if unpublished (EMSC). Not a warning or evidence of a tsunami; check NOAA tsunami.gov for alerts.

updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC time this record was last updated.

title: Get Earthquake Event Detail
